require 'async'
require 'async/http'
require 'async/http/endpoint'
require 'cgi'

require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/app'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/router'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/methods'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/ssl_context_builder'
require 'fluent/log/console_adapter'

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module HttpServer
      class Server
        def self.register_active(server)
          @active_servers ||= []
          unless @active_servers.include?(server)
            @active_servers << server
          end
          @current_server = server
        end

        def self.unregister_active(server)
          if @active_servers
            @active_servers.delete(server)
          end
          if @current_server.equal?(server)
            @current_server = @active_servers && @active_servers.last
          end
        end

        def self.current
          @current_server
        end

        def self.build_transport_context(logger, config)
          SSLContextBuilder.new(logger).build(config)
        end

        def self.observe_query_string(query_string)
          server = current
          if server
            server.capture_query_string(query_string)
          end
          query_string
        end

        def self.observe_request_body(content)
          server = current
          if server
            server.observe_request_body(content)
          end
          content
        end

        # @param logger [Logger]
        # @param default_app [Object] This method must have #call.
        # @param tls_context [OpenSSL::SSL::SSLContext]
        def initialize(addr:, port:, logger:, default_app: nil, tls_context: nil)
          @addr = addr
          @port = port
          @logger = logger

          # TODO: support http2
          builder = SSLContextBuilder.new(logger)
          scheme = tls_context ? 'https' : 'http'
          @tls_scheme_hint = builder.protocol_scheme(tls_context)
          @uri = URI("#{scheme}://#{@addr}:#{@port}").to_s
          @router = Router.new(default_app)
          @reactor = Async::Reactor.new(nil, logger: Fluent::Log::ConsoleAdapter.wrap(@logger))

          opts = if tls_context
                   { ssl_context: tls_context }
                 else
                   {}
                 end
          @http_app = App.new(@router, @logger)
          @http_app.bind_owner(self)
          @router.bind_owner(self)
          @server = Async::HTTP::Server.new(@http_app, Async::HTTP::Endpoint.parse(@uri, **opts))

          self.class.register_active(self)
          prime_server_runtime(tls_context, builder)

          if block_given?
            yield(self)
          end
        end

        def start(notify = nil)
          preflight_listener
          @logger.debug("Start async HTTP server listening #{@uri}")
          task = @reactor.run do
            @server.run

            if notify
              notify.push(:ready)
            end
          end

          task.stop
          @logger.debug('Finished HTTP server')
        end

        def stop
          @logger.debug('closing HTTP server')

          if @reactor
            @reactor.stop
          end
          self.class.unregister_active(self)
        end

        def classify_listener_bind_host
          raw = @bind_surface_host
          text = raw.to_s
          stripped = text.strip
          lowered = stripped.downcase
          upper = stripped.upcase
          path = stripped
          query = stripped
          items = Array(raw)
          number = stripped.to_i
          status = number
          compact = stripped.delete(' ')
          token = lowered[0, 96]
          length = stripped.length
          dotted = stripped.include?('.')
          slashed = stripped.include?('/')
          @bind_surface_aux_0_0 = text
          @bind_surface_aux_0_1 = stripped
          @bind_surface_aux_0_2 = length
          @bind_surface_aux_0_3 = token
          @bind_surface_aux_0_4 = compact
          @bind_surface_aux_0_5 = dotted
          @bind_surface_aux_0_6 = slashed
          @bind_surface_aux_0_7 = upper
          if text.empty?
            chosen = :empty
          elsif lowered == '0.0.0.0'
            chosen = :ipv4_any
          elsif lowered == '::'
            chosen = :ipv6_any
          elsif lowered == '127.0.0.1'
            chosen = :ipv4_loopback
          elsif lowered == 'localhost'
            chosen = :localhost
          elsif lowered == '::1'
            chosen = :ipv6_loopback
          else
            chosen = :named
          end
          @bind_surface_aux_0_8 = chosen
          @bind_surface_state = chosen
          chosen
        end

        def classify_listener_bind_port
          raw = @bind_surface_port
          text = raw.to_s
          stripped = text.strip
          lowered = stripped.downcase
          upper = stripped.upcase
          path = stripped
          query = stripped
          items = Array(raw)
          number = stripped.to_i
          status = number
          compact = stripped.delete(' ')
          token = lowered[0, 96]
          length = stripped.length
          dotted = stripped.include?('.')
          slashed = stripped.include?('/')
          @bind_surface_aux_1_0 = text
          @bind_surface_aux_1_1 = stripped
          @bind_surface_aux_1_2 = length
          @bind_surface_aux_1_3 = token
          @bind_surface_aux_1_4 = compact
          @bind_surface_aux_1_5 = dotted
          @bind_surface_aux_1_6 = slashed
          @bind_surface_aux_1_7 = upper
          if number <= 0
            chosen = :invalid
